text:
Hector: PSA — i accidentally pushed a changelog entry with version `v5..0-rc1` and the CI yelled for a therapist. :sweat_smile:
June: did it also include a tab-indented list? the triple combo is lethal.
Hector: oh yes. full chaos sample:
Hector: ```yaml
changelog:
	- note: fixed typo
version: 'v5..0-rc1'
```
format-bot: Commit rejected: YAMLLintError: Tabs found in YAML; SemverError: 'v5..0-rc1' does not match ^v\d+\.\d+\.\d+$. See https://ci.internal/yaml-rules
Maya: the parser is currently composing an angry haiku. :face_with_raised_eyebrow:
June: quick remediation — replace double-dot with single dot, ensure patch number exists (-> v5.0.0-rc1), and convert tabs to two spaces. plus a small friendly bot message.
Hector: pushing fix now, and adding an apology cookie emoji to the commit. :cookie:
format-bot: Suggested fix applied by CI: normalized version -> 'v5.0.0-rc1' and converted tabs -> 2 spaces. Automated commit: https://ci.internal/auto/1850
Maya: can we get a pre-commit that warns when version looks like Morse code? also a gentle bot reply like: "Did you mean v5.0.0-rc1 or cryptic performance art?"
June: yes to both. PR incoming for pre-commit + a little rule: semver must be three numbers; pre-release labels allowed after that.
Hector: PR opened: https://ci.internal/prs/5012 — includes linter and a tiny funny bot message.
format-bot: Rerun started by Hector (job: jb-1850)
format-bot: Rerun succeeded — staging updated :rocket:
Maya: reward: whoever writes the best semver-pun in the PR description gets a pastry from the kitchen.
Hector: contest accepted. entering: "v5.0.0-rc1: Resurrected from dot-astrophe" :tada:
June: closing thread — remember: tabs are for typewriters, dots are for morse, semver is for humans. :nerd_face:
